# Orion — Developer Toolkit

> Orion is a free, open-source, offline-capable Progressive Web App that bundles 28 developer tools entirely in the browser. No backend, no login, no tracking.

## Project

- **Homepage**: https://vimantha-dilshan.github.io//developer-toolkit/
- **Source code**: https://vimantha-dilshan.github.io//developer-toolkit
- **License**: MIT
- **Version**: 1.0.0
- **Stack**: Vanilla JavaScript (ES Modules), HTML5, CSS3 — zero runtime dependencies in the app core

## Purpose

Orion is designed as a fast, privacy-first alternative to online developer tool sites. All processing happens client-side in the browser. Tools work fully offline after the first load via a Service Worker.

## Tools

### Formatters
- **JSON Formatter** (`/tool/json-formatter`) — Format, validate, minify, and explore JSON with syntax highlighting and tree view.
- **SQL Formatter** (`/tool/sql-formatter`) — Format SQL queries; supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Oracle, and SQL Server.
- **XML Formatter** (`/tool/xml-formatter`) — Format, minify, and validate XML documents.
- **YAML Formatter** (`/tool/yaml-formatter`) — Format, validate, and convert YAML documents.

### Generators
- **UUID Generator** (`/tool/uuid-generator`) — Generate UUID v1, v4, v7, ULID, and NanoID identifiers in bulk.
- **Password Generator** (`/tool/password-generator`) — Generate cryptographically secure passwords with custom rules.
- **Docker Compose Generator** (`/tool/docker-generator`) — Visually generate docker-compose.yml and Dockerfiles for popular stacks.
- **Lorem Ipsum Generator** (`/tool/lorem-ipsum`) — Generate placeholder Lorem Ipsum text for designs and layouts.
- **QR Code Generator** (`/tool/qr-generator`) — Generate QR codes for URLs, text, contact cards, and Wi-Fi credentials.
- **Barcode Generator** (`/tool/barcode-generator`) — Generate CODE128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, and other barcode types.

### Testers
- **Regex Tester** (`/tool/regex-tester`) — Test regular expressions with live match highlighting, flags, and a reference cheatsheet.
- **API Tester** (`/tool/api-tester`) — Test HTTP APIs directly in the browser with full header, body, and auth support.
- **Diff Checker** (`/tool/diff-checker`) — Compare two text blocks side by side and highlight differences.
- **Cron Expression Parser** (`/tool/cron-parser`) — Parse and validate cron expressions with human-readable descriptions.

### Converters
- **Markdown Preview** (`/tool/markdown-preview`) — Write and preview Markdown with GitHub-styled rendering and HTML export.
- **cURL Converter** (`/tool/curl-converter`) — Convert cURL commands to Postman collections and vice versa.
- **CSV ↔ JSON Converter** (`/tool/csv-json`) — Convert CSV to JSON and JSON arrays to CSV with live preview.
- **Timestamp Converter** (`/tool/timestamp-converter`) — Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa.

### Analyzers
- **JWT Decoder** (`/tool/jwt-decoder`) — Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens; shows header, payload, claims, and expiry countdown.
- **ENV Comparator** (`/tool/env-comparator`) — Compare .env files to find missing keys, duplicates, and extra variables.
- **JSON Compare** (`/tool/json-compare`) — Deep compare two JSON objects and highlight structural differences.
- **Hash Generator** (`/tool/hash-generator`) — Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, and other hashes.

### Encoders / Decoders
- **Base64 Tool** (`/tool/base64-tool`) — Encode and decode Base64 strings, files, and images.
- **URL Encoder / Decoder** (`/tool/url-encoder`) — Encode and decode URL strings and query parameters.
- **HTML Encoder / Decoder** (`/tool/html-encoder`) — Encode and decode HTML entities to prevent XSS.

### Design
- **Color Picker** (`/tool/color-picker`) — Pick colors and convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSB, and CSS formats.

### AI Powered
- **AI Commit Generator** (`/tool/ai-commit-generator`) — Generate conventional git commit messages from a diff using an AI provider.

### OpenAPI / API Docs
- **OpenAPI Viewer** (`/tool/openapi-viewer`) — Render and browse OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.x specification files.

## Key Features

- Works entirely offline after first visit (Service Worker + Cache API)
- No data ever leaves the browser — all processing is client-side
- Installable as a PWA on desktop and mobile
- Command palette (Ctrl/Cmd + K) for fast tool navigation
- Keyboard shortcuts for all major tools
- Dark / Light / System theme support
- Favourites and recent-tools history stored in localStorage

## Permissions and Data

Orion does not collect, store, or transmit any user data. There is no analytics by default. All tool state is stored locally in the browser's localStorage under the `devtk_` prefix and never leaves the device.

## Contributing

Contributions welcome via GitHub pull request. Each tool lives in its own self-contained module under `tools/<tool-id>/index.js`.
